remarks: Experience luxury, privacy, and convenience at Middlesex Commons. This coveted end-unit condo is ideally set at the back of the community on the circle, offering rare quiet, space, and a serene setting. With two spacious bedrooms plus a sun-filled dedicated office, the home also offers a unique opportunity to convert to a three-bedroom layout without sacrificing living space. Dramatic two-story living room windows frame peaceful views of the fountain pond and fill the home with natural light. Outside, a private deck and rare side yard create a true sense of green space, perfect for play, pets, or relaxing outdoors. Owned by the same family since it was built, the home has been rebuilt from the studs and transformed with a refined modern aesthetic. Every finish is brand new, including pale oak flooring, a white eat-in kitchen with white and pale gray quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an elegant painted wood-paneled powder room. Each bedroom features its own en suite bath for comfort and privacy. The primary suite bath is a true retreat, featuring Calacatta Gold chevron marble floors, a low-iron glass walk-in shower, freestanding soaking tub, and fluted-front vanity. A pool, pool house, and guest cottage enhance the resort-style feel and provide a welcoming retreat for overnight guests. Just steps to the train and Darien's newly revitalized downtown, this is sophisticated, low-maintenance living in one of Middlesex Commons' most desirable locations.
